commit.message:
Skip redundant find_package(Python3) in generator extensions (#984)

Every rosidl generator extension calls find_package(Python3 REQUIRED
COMPONENTS Interpreter) unconditionally.  Because ament_execute_extensions
includes each extension into the same scope, a single interface package
runs that search once per registered generator -- 13 times for a default
rolling workspace.

CMake does not memoize this.  Each repeat re-enters FindPython/Support.cmake
and re-interrogates the interpreter to confirm the cached value is still
valid: version, -V, sys.copyright, sysconfig paths, EXT_SUFFIX, SOSABI, and
(WIN32 only) ABIFLAGS.  That is roughly seven interpreter launches per call.
On Linux the launches are cheap enough to hide; on Windows CreateProcess for
python.exe costs ~60ms locally and far more on a CI runner, so the repeats
dominate configure time.

Guard each call on the imported target, exactly as ament_cmake_core's
python.cmake already does.  Imported targets are directory scoped, so the
target created by the first search is visible to every later extension and
to functions called from that directory.

Measured on builtin_interfaces (two messages), Windows 11, CMake 4.2, with
all four rosidl repos patched:

  find_package(Python3) calls   13   ->  3
  python.exe spawns             92   -> 22
  cmake configure (median of 5) 17.6s -> 13.1s

The generated build.ninja is byte identical before and after, as are the
Python3_* cache entries.

The three remaining calls are the initial search in ament_cmake_core, one
in rosidl_generator_py which additionally needs the Development and NumPy
components, and one in the ros2-rust generator's add_subdirectory scope.

Companion changes are needed in rosidl_typesupport, rosidl_typesupport_fastrtps
and rosidl_python for the full effect.

Signed-off-by: Michael Carroll <mjcarroll.oss@gmail.com>
